name: enginehost
title: Engine host (SDK synth engines on drwave)
status_note: v1.4: extended tags 8..13 (slots 5-7 tag 7, slot 8 tag - 7) for ACID 3 and PALETTE (sim-verified); v1.3: dot-matrix displays eh_dots.c, antialiased shapes eh_aa.c (sim-verified); v1.2 device-verified
summary: Lets several SDK synth engines share TE's drwave engine: a drwave sound whose knob slots 5-8 carry an engine tag is rendered by that engine (WHEEL, WARP, ...), every other drwave sound by TE. Library feature: engines depend on it and register from their init. Also the engine screens' shared UI: the FX page, the dot-matrix displays (eh_dots.c, 5 x 7 font) and antialiased lines, ellipses and rounded boxes (eh_aa.c).
